overview_description.description:
Lunchbox Technologies develops an online ordering engine for restaurants. It offers various features such as app ordering, web ordering, kiosk, and others that enable restaurants to create customizable digital ordering experiences that keep them fully engaged with their brand.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York.

about_short_description.short_description: Lunchbox Technologies is the premier online ordering system for enterprise restaurant chains to grow their online presence.

product.name: App & Web Ordering
product.description: A platform for managing online orders via branded mobile apps and websites, integrated with major POS systems for real-time order and menu management.

product.name: Catering
product.description: A cloud-based order management solution for streamlining catering operations, including reporting, accounts receivable, prep sheets, and guest communication.

product.name: Order Aggregation
product.description: A system that consolidates in-house and third-party marketplace orders into a restaurant's POS system in real-time, integrating with major delivery platforms.

product.name: Loyalty
product.description: A customizable loyalty program that encourages repeat guest orders through features like tier systems, birthday rewards, and cash back.

product.name: Marketing CRM
product.description: A marketing customer relationship management system that uses first-party data to automate personalized communications via email, SMS, push notifications, and social media.

product.name: Third-Party Manager
product.description: An automated dispute management system that helps restaurants recover lost revenue from third-party order disputes.
